svg.title: Lee–Wang expander: exact real slices at four times
svg.desc: Cone limit t=0 and expanding two-sheeted quadrics at t=0.25, 1, 4, all at the same spatial scale. The full connected three-manifold lives in C3, not R3.
svg.text: Exact real slices · n = 3, k = 2 · full ambient space C³ = R⁶
Same spatial scale; fixed display cutoff r ≤ 3.2. Dashed gray: cone.
The two real sheets connect through the circle direction in R⁶.
These slices are not themselves mean curvature flows in R³.
